texts: A single coffee tree produces only about 1-2 pounds of roasted coffee per year — meaning your daily cup requires the annual harvest from roughly 15-20 trees, making each sip far more resource-intensive than most people realize.

The coffee industry supports approximately 100 million farmers and workers globally, yet 70% of them live below the poverty line despite coffee being a $200 billion annual industry — making your morning cup one of the most inequitable commodities in the world.

Theodor Seuss Geisel, better known as Dr. Seuss, was a cartoonist for Standard Coffee in the 1940s before he wrote The Cat in the Hat — his first commercial artwork featured a cartoon elephant helping roast beans, using the same rhythmic rhyming style he'd later make famous in children's books.
